title: Convert triangle patches into degenerate quads (re-enable strip equivalence chain)
description:
Filed during PATCH-83 diagnostic deep-dive. Lyon paper's T-mesh has only rectangular patches; ours has 153/272 triangles on rocker-arm at alpha=15 deg, blocking strip-equivalence chain propagation (PATCH-84 v1 unifies 232 of an expected 2561 arc pairs because chains break at every triangle).

Fix: in TPatchEnumerator, when a face cycle has 3 corners, emit it as a 4-sided patch with one side being a degenerate single-arc that has parametric length 0 (or equivalently, the singularity at the apex is duplicated as two corners on the degenerate side). This matches Lyon's framework where 3-valent singularities are still 4-corner cells in the layout, just with one side that quantizes to 0.

Impact: rocker-arm strip-equivalence should drop #Vars from 2521 toward 192. Hand-30k similar reduction.
definition-of-done: Rocker-arm at alpha=15 deg: #Vars drops from current 2521 to under 500 (closer to paper 192). All emitted patches are 4-sided. Hand-30k same property.
testing-plan: Toy 3-valent singularity fixture: verify the wedge emerges as a 4-corner patch with one degenerate side. Rocker-arm regression: assert nVars/nArcs ratio improves.
